title: 第5章 闪电武魂
content_zh:
石岩睁开眼，望着不远处的那些药奴，怔怔出神。

这些人大多数是因为家境贫寒，不得已才和墨颜玉定下协议成为药奴的，只要能够支撑半年，他们不但可以得到自由，还能够得到两百个紫晶币，当然，如果是因为试药而死，他们的亲人同样可以得到这一笔钱。

在神恩大陆，一个黑晶币等于一百紫晶币，等于一万蓝晶币，普通老百姓一年的收入，也就五六个紫晶币而已，两百个紫晶币，药奴要干四十年才能够赚到。

协议签订的那一天，他们的亲人就得到了五十紫晶币，剩余的也会在半年后交给他们，若是他们不幸死了，那些紫晶币会落到他们的亲人手中，两百个紫色晶币，对这些人来说，或许一辈子的努力都挣不到，也是因为如此，他们才会铤而走险。

然而，当初他们定下协议的时候，根本就没有想到试药会那么残酷，几乎每隔几天，他们中就有一人因试药而死，并且死状都极其凄惨，这让他们惶恐不可终日，进而滋生诸多想法。

可惜协议上白纸黑字写的明明白白，一旦签订，不得中途退出，也就是说，这半年时间他们将自己的性命交给他了墨家，只要他们不服从协议，胆敢偷偷溜走，墨家有权利杀死他们。

天上不会掉馅饼，等他们意识到试药的残酷时，早已经晚了，也只能硬撑下去。

石岩心中明白，这些人一个都撑不到那一天，他知道这些药奴早晚会死，或许明天就有人会因试药丧命，他自知自己能力有限，无力改变这一切，所以避免和他们多接触，没有一点交情，这些人死的时候他才不会有伤悲。

石岩皱着眉头，悄悄望了一眼高高坐在地龙轿子内的炼药师卡鲁，又迅速收回目光。

从卡鲁胸口绣着的五个白药瓶，他知道这是一个凡级五品的炼药师，炼药师是这个世界上比武者还要稀罕的一个特殊人群。

每一个炼药师几乎都是一个武者，他们炼制出来的药丸能够增进武者的修为，极少数厉害的炼药师炼制出来特殊的药丸，甚至可以增进“武魂”的能力。

和武者十大境界的划分不同，炼药师根据在丹药造诣上的强弱，在神恩大陆上被划分为五种等级，分别为凡级、玄级、灵级、圣级、神级，每一级别又分为七品。

炼药师每个级别都有着特殊标志，凡级炼药师胸口绣着白药瓶，玄级胸口炼药师绣火炎，灵级胸口绣药草，圣级胸口绣丹丸，神级胸口绣药鼎，卡鲁胸口绣着五个白药瓶，就是凡级五品的修为，一眼明了。

由于炼药师的药丸可以改变武者，可以让武者精元得到提升，这让炼药师在武者中的地位极高，又因为炼药师的稀少，使得每一个炼药师几乎都成了各大势力争逐的对象，让炼药师地位更加水涨船高。

卡鲁这个凡级五品的炼药师，就是墨颜玉为墨家从神佑帝国的药王谷请来的，墨家和石家一样，也是商盟五大世家之一，墨家也有“武魂”，“武魂”为闪电之力，墨家很多人天生就有“闪电武魂”，并且随着境界的提升而逐渐增长。

而墨颜玉，便是拥有“闪电武魂”的墨家嫡传一代年轻高手。

墨家在商盟经营药材生意，一直都在网罗各地炼药师为自家炼药，可炼药师各个性格怪癖，又自视奇高，很少有人会愿意受世家约束，因此墨家始终不能如愿。

虽然卡鲁只是一名凡级五品的炼药师，但墨家能说动他也着实不容易，这一趟墨颜玉也不知通过什么方法说动了卡鲁，让这卡鲁愿意从药王谷出来，答应了去墨家炼药。

可这卡鲁似乎不走正道，他对于炼药师视为歪门邪道的毒药一学兴趣极大，而毒药的炼制若想要达到精确细致，用妖兽试药都不行，必须要用活人，这才有了那些药奴。

“出发！”远处传来了墨颜玉的一声轻喝，众多休息着的武者纷纷做起来，收拾了一下准备上路，蹲在一块儿的药奴也赶紧站起来，生怕会慢上几步挨打。

石岩默默站起来，冷眼望了望队伍最前方那一道身姿妙曼却心如毒蝎的倩影，微不可闻的冷哼一声，旋即乖乖跟上前面的队伍。

在商盟，墨家和石家关系本来就不佳，墨颜玉的五叔，就是在三年前和石家争夺一座矿山的时候，被石家的石砀给打死的，事后墨家疯狂报复，也杀了石家不少护卫，因为这事，两家私底下没少暗斗。

石岩知道自己若是暴露了原主人的身份，不但不会得到释放，恐怕还会死的更快。

还好这一具身体的原主人，因为不具备“武魂”，又天生不喜武道，很多商盟的武道活动从来都不参加，以至于墨颜玉根本不认识他，要不然他现在处境说不定更加糟糕。

墨家队伍在小河边扎营，地龙发出“呼哧呼哧”的声音，在河边安静的歇息，墨家那些武者吃着干肉，嘿嘿怪笑着谈论商盟晴楼几个远近闻名的的表子。

几名胆大包天的武者，在墨颜玉背对着他们的时候，视线会时不时偷偷在她玲珑有致的身上瞄上两眼，暗暗吞咽着口水，心里面却明白墨颜玉这种级别这种身份的女人，不是他们可以染指的，也只能过过眼瘾罢了。

石岩默默坐下来，正准备继续运转体内的精元，突然发现墨颜玉和卡鲁两人，一起从队伍的最前方直朝着他走来。

石岩心中一寒，知道要有祸事降临，脸色渐渐阴沉了下来。

“断肠散药力太强，一般的平民根本撑不住，才六天就死了两个，看样子也只有武者才能够承受，那小子养了这么久，我看最近恢复了不少，该派上用场了……”卡鲁阴森森地笑着，左手端着一碗黑糊糊的药剂。

“大师不用客气，这人大师随便折腾，可别让他死的太轻松了。”墨颜玉轻笑道。

“嘿嘿，这一点墨小姐尽管放心，既然落到了我卡鲁手上，那肯定没有痛痛快快死掉的道理，断肠散的药力你之前也看到了，那几个平民可都是浑身慢慢腐烂才死去的，这小子身体越强，腐烂的速度就会越慢，痛苦自然也会越来越大，你就好好看着吧。”卡鲁哈哈大笑，一点不顾及不远处石岩的感受。

“那最好不过。”墨颜玉点头，美眸寒光四溢，显然是把石岩恨到骨子里了。

两人说说笑笑，不多时便来到了石岩身旁，卡鲁也不废话，将那一碗黑糊糊的断肠散递到石岩面前，冷声道：“小子，给我喝了他。”

墨颜玉伸出雪嫩的左手，炫目的电芒在她左手五指上游动着，从小指慢慢缠绕向大拇指，像是一条活动着的灵巧电蛇，“闪电武魂”和精元结合，丝丝缕缕的能量波动将空气炸的“啪啪”爆响，

“嘿嘿！”强森冷笑声从石岩背后传来，“小子，你要是胆敢不喝，下场会如何，你是知道的。”

卡鲁眸中满是兴奋，忍不住搓了搓手，叫道：“小子，断肠散很有趣的，他会让你从肠子开始一点点腐烂……”

墨颜玉冷冷地看着石岩，一瞬不移，只等石岩反抗，只要石岩表现出丝毫的不配合，她会立即雷霆出手，做好了在石岩身上狠狠发泄一番的打算。

这些天来，她一想起石岩对她的肆意侵犯，就一肚子气，那连未婚夫都还没有机会碰触的禁地，让石岩给先尝了鲜嫩，这让她郁闷羞愧到几欲吐血。

“我喝。”石岩淡淡回了一句，稳稳将那一碗断肠散接住，一饮而尽。
content_en:
Shi Yan opened his eyes and looked at the medicine slaves not far away, stunned.

Most of these people had no choice but to make an agreement with Mo Yanyu to become drug slaves because their families were poor. As long as they could last for half a year, they would not only be free, but also receive two hundred amethyst coins. Of course, if they died due to drug testing, their relatives could also receive this money.

In the Divine Grace Continent, one black crystal coin is equal to one hundred amethyst coins, which is equal to ten thousand blue crystal coins. The annual income of ordinary people is only five or six amethyst coins. It takes a medicine slave forty years to earn two hundred amethyst coins.

On the day the agreement was signed, their relatives received fifty amethyst coins, and the rest would be handed over to them half a year later. If they unfortunately died, those amethyst coins would fall into the hands of their relatives. Two hundred purple crystal coins may not be earned by these people with a lifetime of hard work. It is also because of this that they take desperate risks.

However, when they made the agreement, they never thought that testing the drug would be so cruel. Almost every few days, one of them would die due to the drug testing, and the death was extremely miserable. This made them terrified all day long, which gave rise to many ideas.

Unfortunately, the agreement was clearly written in black and white. Once signed, they were not allowed to withdraw midway. In other words, they had given their lives to the Mo family in the past six months. As long as they disobeyed the agreement and dared to sneak away, the Mo family had the right to kill them.

There is no pie in the sky. By the time they realize the cruelty of testing drugs, it is already too late and they can only hold on.

Shi Yan knew in his heart that none of these people would survive that day. He knew that these drug slaves would die sooner or later, and maybe someone would die tomorrow due to testing the medicine. He knew that he had limited abilities and was unable to change everything, so he avoided having more contact with them. Without any friendship, he would not feel sad when these people died.

Shi Yan frowned and glanced quietly at Alchemist Kalu, who was sitting high in the Earth Dragon sedan, and quickly looked away.

From the five white medicine bottles embroidered on Kalu's chest, he knew that this was a fifth-grade mortal alchemist. Alchemists are a special group of people in this world that are rarer than warriors.

Almost every alchemist is a warrior. The pills they refine can improve the martial artist's cultivation. A very small number of powerful alchemists refine special pills that can even enhance the ability of the "martial spirit".

Different from the division of the ten realms of warriors, alchemists are divided into five levels in Shen'en Continent based on their strength in elixir attainment, namely mortal level, mysterious level, spiritual level, holy level, and divine level. Each level is divided into seven levels.

Each level of an alchemist has a special symbol. A mortal-level alchemist has a white medicine bottle embroidered on his chest, a mysterious-level alchemist has fire flames embroidered on his chest, a spirit-level alchemist has herb embroidered on his chest, a saint-level alchemist has pills embroidered on his chest, a divine-level medicine cauldron is embroidered on his chest, and five white medicine bottles are embroidered on Kalu's chest. It is clear at a glance that he is a fifth-grade mortal level.

Because the alchemist's pills can transform warriors and improve their essence, this gives the alchemist a very high status among warriors. And because of the scarcity of alchemists, almost every alchemist has become the target of competition among major forces, making the alchemist's status even higher.

Kalu, a fifth-level mortal alchemist, was invited by Mo Yanyu from the Medicine King Valley of the Divine Bless Empire for the Mo family. The Mo family, like the Shi family, is one of the five major families in the Merchant Alliance. The Mo family also has a "martial spirit", and the "martial spirit" is the power of lightning. Many people in the Mo family are born with a "lightning martial spirit", and it gradually increases with the improvement of their realm.

And Mo Yanyu is a young master from the direct descendant of the Mo family who possesses the "Lightning Martial Spirit".

The Mo family runs a medicinal business in the Merchant Alliance, and has been recruiting alchemists from all over the country to refine medicine for the family. However, the alchemists have eccentric personalities and have extremely high self-esteem. Few of them are willing to be restrained by the family, so the Mo family has never been able to do so.

Although Kalu is only a fifth-grade mortal alchemist, it is not easy for the Mo family to persuade him. Mo Yanyu did not know how to persuade Kalu this time, so that Kalu was willing to come out of the Medicine King Valley and agreed to go to the Mo family to refine medicine.

But this Kalu doesn't seem to be on the right path. He is very interested in poisons, which are regarded as evil practices by pharmacists. If the refining of poisons is to be precise and meticulous, it is not possible to use monsters to test the medicine. Living people must be used, which is why those medicine slaves are there.

"Let's go!" A soft shout from Mo Yanyu came from the distance. Many warriors who were resting started to do it one after another, packed up and prepared to go on the road. The medicine slaves who were squatting together also stood up quickly, for fear that they would be beaten if they took a few steps too late.

Shi Yan stood up silently, looked coldly at the beautiful figure at the front of the team with a graceful figure but a heart as poisonous as a scorpion, snorted inaudibly, and then followed the team in front obediently.

In the business alliance, the relationship between the Mo family and the Shi family was not good. Mo Yanyu's fifth uncle was beaten to death by Shi Dang of the Shi family when they competed with the Shi family for a mine three years ago. Afterwards, the Mo family retaliated wildly and killed many of the Shi family's guards. Because of this, the two families secretly fought secretly.

Shi Yan knew that if he exposed the identity of the original owner, not only would he not be released, but he would probably die faster.

Fortunately, the original owner of this body, because he did not have a "martial spirit" and was not naturally fond of martial arts, never participated in many martial arts activities of the Merchant Alliance, so that Mo Yanyu did not know him at all, otherwise his current situation might be even worse.

The Mohist team camped by the river. The earth dragon made a "huchihuchi" sound and rested quietly by the river. The Mohist warriors ate dried meat and laughed strangely as they talked about the famous cousins ​​of Shangmeng Qinglou.

Several brave warriors, when Mo Yanyu's back was turned to them, would secretly glance at her exquisite body from time to time. They swallowed secretly, but they knew in their hearts that a woman of Mo Yanyu's level and status was not something they could get involved with, and they could only enjoy it.

Shi Yan sat down silently and was about to continue to use the essence in his body when he suddenly found Mo Yanyu and Kalu walking straight towards him from the front of the team.

Shi Yan felt a chill in his heart, knowing that something bad was about to happen, and his face gradually darkened.

"The power of Broken Heart Powder is too strong. Ordinary civilians can't bear it. Two people died in just six days. It seems that only warriors can bear it. The kid has been raised for so long. I think he has recovered a lot recently. It's time to put it to use..." Kalu smiled sinisterly, holding a bowl of dark potion in his left hand.

"Master, you're welcome. Master, you can do whatever you want with this guy, but don't let him die too easily." Mo Yanyu chuckled.

"Hey, Miss Mo, don't worry about this. Since it fell into the hands of me, Kalu, there is definitely no reason to die quickly. You have seen the power of Changchang Powder before. Those civilians died because their whole bodies were slowly rotting. The stronger this kid's body, the slower the rot will be, and the pain will naturally become more and more severe. Just watch it." Kalu laughed, not caring about Shi Yan's feelings not far away.

"That's the best." Mo Yanyu nodded, her beautiful eyes filled with cold light, and she obviously hated Shi Yan to the core.

The two chatted and laughed, and soon they came to Shi Yan. Kalu didn't waste any time, and handed the bowl of black heartbroken powder to Shi Yan, saying in a cold voice: "Boy, drink it for me."

Mo Yanyu stretched out her snow-nen left hand, and the dazzling electric light swam on the five fingers of her left hand, slowly winding from the little finger to the thumb, like a moving and dexterous electric snake. The "Lightning Martial Spirit" and the essence were combined, and the strands of energy fluctuations made the air explode with a "pop" sound.

"Hehe!" Johnson's sneer came from behind Shi Yan, "Boy, if you dare not drink, you know what will happen."

Kalu's eyes were full of excitement and he couldn't help but rub his hands and shouted: "Boy, Duangchang Powder is very interesting. It will make you rot from the intestines bit by bit..."

Mo Yanyu looked at Shi Yan coldly, without moving for a moment, just waiting for Shi Yan to resist. As long as Shi Yan showed the slightest lack of cooperation, she would immediately take action and was ready to vent her anger on Shi Yan.

These days, when she thought of Shi Yan's wanton violation of her, she became angry. Shi Yan had tasted the forbidden area that even her fiancé had not had a chance to touch, which made her feel so depressed and ashamed that she almost wanted to vomit blood.

"I'll drink it." Shi Yan replied lightly, steadily caught the bowl of Broken Heart Powder and drank it all in one gulp.
